subject: AromaUnitTotalCnBinarySet$byName- Error in cdf[[1]] : subscript out of bounds

messages.author: 8288c445312ca5fe
messages.subject: AromaUnitTotalCnBinarySet$byName- Error in cdf[[1]] : subscript out of bounds
parts:
Hi All,

    I was following the online viginette http://www.aroma-project.org/howtos/exportTotalCnRatioSet to export total Copy Number Ratios, i have ran CRMAv2 without problem, but when I try to do the following i got the error in cdf, anyone has similar experience to share?

Thanks
CK

> cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6")
> csR_CHI <- AffymetrixCelSet$byName("47Chinese_CEL", cdf=cdf)
> tags <- "ACC,ra,-XY,BPN,-XY,AVG,A+B,FLN,-XY" 
> chipType <- "GenomeWideSNP_6"
> ds_CHI <- AromaUnitTotalCnBinarySet$byName(csR_CHI, tags=tags, chipType=chipType)
Error in cdf[[1]] : subscript out of bounds

messages.subject: Re: [aroma.affymetrix] AromaUnitTotalCnBinarySet$byName- Error in cdf[[1]] : subscript out of bounds

On Mon, Feb 4, 2013 at 4:14 PM, <ahke...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Hi All,
>
> I was following the online viginette
> http://www.aroma-project.org/howtos/exportTotalCnRatioSet to export total
> Copy Number Ratios, i have ran CRMAv2 without problem, but when I try to do
> the following i got the error in cdf, anyone has similar experience to
> share?
>
> Thanks
> CK
>
>> cdf <- AffymetrixCdfFile$byChipType("GenomeWideSNP_6")
>> csR_CHI <- AffymetrixCelSet$byName("47Chinese_CEL", cdf=cdf)
>> tags <- "ACC,ra,-XY,BPN,-XY,AVG,A+B,FLN,-XY"
>> chipType <- "GenomeWideSNP_6"
>> ds_CHI <- AromaUnitTotalCnBinarySet$byName(csR_CHI, tags=tags,
>> chipType=chipType)
> Error in cdf[[1]] : subscript out of bounds

Did you really mean to use object 'csR_CHI' in that last call, or did you mean:

ds_CHI <- AromaUnitTotalCnBinarySet$byName("47Chinese_CEL", tags=tags,
chipType=chipType)

?

Henrik
